an10.81:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā campāyaṃ viharati gaggarāya pokkharaṇiyā tīre.
an10.81:1.2: athakho āyasmā vāhuno yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā vāhuno bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
an10.81:1.3: katīhi nu kho bhante dhammehi tathāgato nissaṭo visaṃyutto vippamutto vimariyādikatena cetasā viharatīti.
an10.81:2.1: dasahi kho vāhuna dhammehi tathāgato nissaṭo visaṃyutto vippamutto vimariyādikatena cetasā viharati
an10.81:2.3: rūpena kho vāhuna tathāgato nissaṭo visaṃyutto vippamutto vimariyādikatena cetasā viharati
an10.81:2.12: kilesehi kho vāhuna tathāgato nissaṭo visaṃyutto vippamutto vimariyādikatena cetasā viharati
an10.81:2.13: seyyathāpi vāhuna uppalaṃ vā padumaṃ vā puṇḍarīkaṃ vā udake jātaṃ udake saṃvaḍḍhaṃ udakā accuggamma tiṭṭhati anupalittaṃ udakena
an10.81:2.14: evameva kho vāhuna imehi dasahi dhammehi tathāgato nissaṭo visaṃyutto vippamutto vimariyādikatena cetasā viharatīti.
